desc: Introducing the new LE Small Latch Sledgehammer AR-15 Charging Handle from Breek Arms, engineered for enthusiasts and professionals who demand top-tier performance and rock-solid reliability when shooting suppressed. Machined from aerospace-grade 7075-T6 aluminum, its compact LE small latch and serrated, wider-footprint design deliver rugged durability and an effortless, snag-free grab for fast, confident manipulation. With class-leading gas-reduction ports that divert gases away from the shooter and performance-first engineering at an approachable price, the Sledgehammer is the smart upgrade for your rifle this season.
